1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __consisting essentially of an alkaline solution having a pH greater than 10__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b) __to identify specific genetic markers for trait selection__; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __wherein said cold exposure comprises incubation at 4°C for at least 10 minutes__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least three times__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __wherein said heating comprises incubation at 95°C for at least 5 minutes__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least three times__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __selected from the group consisting of cellulase, pectinase, and hemicellulase__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME® __and the incubation is performed at 50°C for 2 hours__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using a silica-based column purification method__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __wherein the magnetic particles are functionalized with nucleic acid binding moieties__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __having a moisture content of at least 35%__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) __wherein said storing comprises maintaining the embryos in a controlled atmosphere at 4°C__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __for determining the presence or absence of at least one transgene__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __wherein the genotyping is performed using quantitative PCR__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __wherein said phenotyping comprises measuring at least one agronomic trait__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __using multiple displacement amplification__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __wherein said selecting comprises identifying embryos having a desired combination of at least two genetic markers__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __within 48 hours of said selecting__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __using robotic liquid handling systems__.
